official_title: ACORD 25: Certificate of Liability Insurance (COI) — AMS Holder Roster Schema
issuer: ACORD Corporation (bring your agency's own licensed ACORD 25 PDF)

pdf_architecture.notes: AMS exports (Applied Epic, AMS360, HawkSoft, EZLynx) may emit either fillable AcroForm PDFs or flattened PDFs; field names vary by ACORD edition and AMS vendor.

columns.format_notes: Issue date in MM/DD/YYYY; commonly fixed across a renewal COI batch.
Issuing insurance agency or brokerage legal name.
Agency mailing address; often locked on reusable template.
Agency contact phone (fictional 555-01xx in examples).
Agency certificate desk email address.
Must match Named Insured exactly as written on underlying policies.
Insured mailing street, city, state, and ZIP.
Carrier legal name affording Commercial General Liability coverage.
5-digit NAIC company code; keep as Text to preserve leading zeros.

columns.pdf_field_example: COVERAGES: Commercial General Liability POLICY NUMBER
columns.format_notes: Underlying CGL policy number (update once per annual renewal).
CGL policy effective date.
CGL policy expiration date.
Formatted dollar limit (e.g., $1,000,000); watch narrow box truncation.
Formatted dollar limit (e.g., $2,000,000).
Y or N indicator placed in narrow ADDL INSD box.
Y or N indicator placed in narrow SUBR WVD box.
Multiline project/job/endorsement wording that varies per holder row.
Landlord, GC, lender, or client requesting evidence of coverage.
Certificate holder street address and suite.
Certificate holder city, state, and ZIP (preserve leading-zero ZIPs).
